answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that vests slowly, like crystal forming layer by layer: a fresh identity can trade only small amounts until its deposit and a history of honest work mature. A sybil swarm then pays real money per fake account, frozen for weeks, while honest agents earn the stake back. Reputation accrues in a public nebula of linked attestations, so a sockpuppet with no history looks dim beside established peers. Cheap identities crumble like shale under that cost; only identities that survived time and capital earn trust.
